title: Tsarevets (fortress)
scope: Baldwin’s Tower, the surviving 1933 stone restoration at Tsarevets Fortress in Veliko Tarnovo, with its stair and immediately attached stretches of the cliff-edge curtain.
limitations: The tower and immediately adjoining curtain are modeled. The northern and western castle circuit, skyline church, and other foundations belong to the wider site.
The standing profile follows the surviving photograph and mapped footprint. Precise stonework, door and stair details, wall top grades and close cliff footing are approximations.
